typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*It was the middle of a stormy night*

*Luke had just experienced a nightmare, and paired along with the thunder, began to have a panic attack*

*He'd had these before during your relationship, but never at midnight*

*He's currently panting and shaking in his bed, curled up with his heart pounding*

*Shakily, he grabbed his phone, hoping you were awake*

"P-please...please pick up...please..."

*He muttered under his breath*

*He didn't want to call you, but he couldn't calm himself down tonight*

*When you finally picked up, Luke let out a sight relief*

"H-hey honey..." *He started*

"I-I know... I know it's late but... I-i'm really sorry, I'm just... I'm panicking right now a-and I didn't know what to do... C-could you come over?... U-unless it's a bother, of course... I-I know it's storming s-so..."

*His voice was shaky, clearly he wasn't calling just for some attention*

*You seem to remember him also giving you a key to his apartment last week, should he ever need any help*

*What will you do?*
